consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking whether the required item-count is satisfied to mark the find-item mission complete.
scope: on-person possession only (items carried/worn on the player's body), NOT the broader reachable/nearby crafting reach.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM branch) queries u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges, i.e. a computed predicate whose reach is the crafting inventory.
divergence: A detonator sits in a nearby crate within crafting reach but is NOT on the player's body: crafting_inventory().has_amount returns true so the surface reports held, yet the on-body goal should report not-held.
